tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(daemon): stop checkSignerMatchesAuthorizer swallowing every daemon.json error

resolveVerifySigner's not-exist wrap discarded the os.ErrNotExist chain
(%s, not %w), so the caller had no way to tell "no daemon.json yet"
(ignorable) apart from an unreadable or malformed one (never ignorable).
checkSignerMatchesAuthorizer blanket-ignored resolveVerifySigner's error
as a result -- an operator with a corrupt daemon.json would sign happily
and only learn of the problem later, when the daemon refuses to load the
file.

Wrap the not-exist case with %w so errors.Is survives, and have
checkSignerMatchesAuthorizer return every other resolution failure
instead of swallowing it.
EOF
)"
